relationship.changes_from_v0: Replace image-derived Survey_Nights with installation/retrieval calendar span only; new separately versioned structural target

source.known_from_public_webpage: Deployment Start_Date and End_Date are given as camera physical placement/retrieval dates; Survey_Nights is based on first/last detected images per Rooney et al. (2026).

primary_estimand: Number of unique Project×Camera_Trap_Array×Site_Name sites in each frozen forest/grassland habitat with at least one single camera calendar placement/retrieval interval of >=30 nights, excluding ambiguous/hard-fail metadata

habitat_groups.selection: casefold(Habitat) includes exactly one literal substring 'forest' or 'grassland'; otherwise exclude

site_and_deployment.same_site_duplicate_deployments: Use MAX nonnegative End_Date - Start_Date across distinct rows, never sum even if disjoint; output duplicate conflicts only in aggregates
site_and_deployment.invalid_calendar_span: missing, malformed, negative or >366 days excluded from qualifying interval and counted
site_and_deployment.contradictory_same_site_coordinates: if two rounded-to-4-decimals valid coordinate pairs disagree, exclude site
site_and_deployment.contradictory_site_state_or_habitat: exclude site from selected primary groups

metrics: within-site max single placement calendar span >=30
structural_gate: Both frozen habitats have >=8 eligible unique sites AND >=8 arrays; this is NOT an iid sampling or power gate.
fail_closed: If frozen Dryad deployment CSV unavailable or invalid, report SOURCE_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE; do not open sequence CSV or substitute another metadata version.
